definitions.meaning: the sun is one instance of a thing that shines, an example of shining
a model case held up for others to copy

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: the sun is a specimen of something that glows, and a model instance is the idiom for an ideal to follow.

clue.text: Some of the best looking in town in France

indicators.note: Some of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A remark that some of the most attractive people live in a particular French town.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft's definition included the second 'in', which is only a link joining the wordplay to 'town in France'.
explanation.definitionFit: Saint-Lô is a market town in Normandy, northern France.

clue.text: A farmer and reaper initially long way off

indicators.note: initially asks for the opening letter of each of the four words before it

explanation.surface: A farmer and his reaper are out in a distant field.
explanation.definitionFit: Distant, at a great remove, is the meaning of this adverb.

indicators.note: most of says the word for joined loses its final letter

parts.note: joined means attached, fastened on

explanation.surface: Someone claims to have linked up nearly all of a legal matter.
explanation.definitionFit: An attaché case is a slim briefcase, so the first word of the phrase can stand for the case.

definitions.meaning: a territory governed by another country
reliance on a drug or habit

explanation.definitionFit: A territory ruled from abroad is a dependent state, and needing a substance is a reliance on it.

clue.text: It cuts beef with a drink that had been prepared

indicators.note: prepared means made ready, so these letters are put into a new order

explanation.surface: Something slices up beef, served alongside a cocktail mixed beforehand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'prepared' rearranges BEEF, A and DRINK; 'with' and 'that had been' only join.
explanation.definitionFit: A serrated kitchen blade for slicing loaves is a tool that cuts.

clue.text: Containing most recent news just having been ironed?

definitions.meaning: freshly printed, carrying the latest stories
the question mark flags a fanciful sense: newly taken off a flat iron, still warm

explanation.definitionFit: Freshly printed newspapers carry the latest stories, and laundry just lifted from the iron is still warm.

clue.text: Understanding purpose of viewing article above headland

indicators.note: in a down clue the article sits above the headland word

parts.note: viewing means seeing, looking at
the definite article
a point is a promontory jutting into the sea

explanation.surface: A grammar puzzle about what the purpose is of viewing an article placed over a promontory.
explanation.definitionFit: To grasp the purpose of something is to get its gist, an idiom of comprehension.

clue.text: You can't help but see it being aggressive and confrontational

definitions.text: You can't help but see it
definitions.meaning: something held right before one's eyes, impossible to miss

explanation.definitionFit: Something right before one's eyes cannot be missed; the same idiom describes brash, provocative behaviour.

clue.text: North American Indian from east Utah first

indicators.note: first says the Utah abbreviation is placed before the east letter

parts.note: UT is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Utah
E is the compass abbreviation for east

explanation.surface: A Native American who came from eastern Utah originally.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads 'east Utah' as a region, but 'first' puts Utah ahead of east.
explanation.definitionFit: The Ute are a Native American people of the Great Basin, after whom Utah is named.

definitions.meaning: gone to bed for the night
read as two words, a flower bed is one place in a garden

explanation.definitionFit: The word means lying in one's bed, having gone to sleep; split, it suggests sitting in a flowerbed.

parts.note: a wordless gesture of the head that signals yes without speaking

explanation.definitionFit: A dip of the head agrees silently, saying yes without a word.

parts.note: open-handed usually means generous, but here it is literal: fists relaxed into open palms

explanation.definitionFit: Relaxing a fist literally opens the hand, punning on open-handed as generous.

parts.note: the place at a sports ground where players get into kit, not a space that alters

explanation.definitionFit: At a gym or stadium, athletes change clothes in the room lined with lockers.

clue.text: Pseudonym of Scotsman turning up with fruit found in river

indicators.note: in a down clue turning up means the word for Scotsman is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: Mon is a stock crossword Scotsman, from Scots 'mon' for man

indicators.note: found in says the fruit is placed inside the river

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Scotland and Wales
a plum is a stone fruit

explanation.surface: A Scotsman's pen name arises from fruit discovered floating in a river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning up' reverses the Scotsman, read from bottom to top in a down clue; 'found in' sets the fruit inside the river. 'with' only joins, and 'of' links the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A pen name is the French-derived phrase writers use for an assumed name.

indicators.note: found in says the answer is a run of letters within the word that follows

explanation.surface: A monarch is located in Buckingham Palace, the London royal residence.
explanation.definitionFit: A male monarch is a sovereign who rules.

clue.text: Kindly reception sometimes on the mat

definitions.meaning: a friendly greeting given to a visitor
a doormat often has a greeting word printed on it

explanation.definitionFit: A warm greeting is a friendly reception, and doormats often carry that greeting word.

clue.text: Any exit taken out of uneasiness

indicators.note: taken out suggests the letters are pulled apart and put back in a new order

explanation.surface: Every way out has been removed, a cause of nervousness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taken out' shuffles ANY and EXIT; 'of' only joins.
explanation.definitionFit: Worry and nervous unease are synonyms for this feeling.

clue.text: Penny left paignton resort turning away from sin

indicators.note: resort, read as re-sort, says the remaining letters are sorted again
left means departed, so the penny letter goes from the town name

parts.note: P is the abbreviation for a penny in British money

explanation.surface: A penny was spent at Paignton, a seaside resort in Devon, England, turning one from sin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'left' removes P from PAIGNTON, leaving AIGNTON; 'resort' (read as sort again) rearranges it. Paignton is a seaside resort town in Devon.
explanation.definitionFit: Making amends for wrongdoing is a form of repentance, a turn from wrongdoing.

indicators.note: endlessly says the word for tired loses its last letter

parts.note: jaded means tired, weary

explanation.surface: An exhausted nag, weary without end.
explanation.definitionFit: A jade is an old word for a broken-down, worn-out nag.

clue.text: Going into flat suitable for first-time user

parts.note: going into a place is making an entry
flat means level, even

explanation.surface: Moving into a flat that suits a newcomer to the property ladder.
explanation.definitionFit: Beginner-grade products are pitched at the lowest tier, for novices.

definitions.meaning: the way something ..., as the ... of the land or a golf ball
an untruth, a statement meant to mislead

explanation.definitionFit: How something rests is its lie, as in golf; a falsehood is also a lie.

clue.text: Runs over personal assistant on strike

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

indicators.note: over means turned over, so the assistant's letters are written backwards

explanation.surface: A car runs over a secretary who is taking industrial action.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' reverses PA to AP; 'on' only joins.
explanation.definitionFit: To rap is to knock or hit sharply.

indicators.note: tailless says the word for jet loses its final letter

parts.note: a spurt is a jet of liquid

explanation.surface: A jet without a tail fin is urged to keep going.
explanation.definitionFit: To urge or goad onward is to spur, as a rider does a horse.

definitions.meaning: Henry Wadsworth ..., American poet of Hiawatha

explanation.definitionFit: The American poet's surname, split, describes a tall man, one who stands high.

indicators.note: in says the left letter is put inside the word for cooler

parts.note: a fan cools the air

explanation.surface: A pastry is left to set in the refrigerator.
explanation.definitionFit: An open pastry case with a filling is a kind of tart.

indicators.note: stopped short says the word for landlord loses its final letter

parts.note: a laird is a Scottish landowner

explanation.surface: A landlord halted before reaching a hideaway.
explanation.definitionFit: A wild animal's hidden home is its den.

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British Army corps
credit means praise, commendation

explanation.surface: Engineers deserve praise for their proposal.
explanation.definitionFit: Advice offered as the best course is a suggestion.
